assessments.task: Distinguish the s1233 stomach exterior from the independent authored mucosal section and locate the repeated rugae cues.

axes.observation: All 13 selections, including the s1233 exterior, closed-back teaching section and eleven authored folds, retain their original geometry, UVs and materials. Scene transforms and the translation clip are exact.

Four pixel-identical neutral task views separate the long repaired exterior from the independent section rim and the raised folds. Undulations on the case exterior and the schematic section outline remain visible.
With only the source surface visible, I located the full curved exterior. Switching to the authored section revealed its rim and eleven repeated fold cues in front and at an oblique angle.

The full 13-mesh scene uses 60,456 triangles and 2,992,144 bytes, saving 410,040 bytes (12.1%). The normal, base-color and roughness PNGs decode identically. Four matched exterior and fold views have identical RGBA pixels.

assessments.task: Find the posterior bare area relative to the anterior surface of the HRA liver.

axes.observation: The HRA capsule, bare area and six selectable ligament meshes retain every source position and index, their scene placement, and the illustrative colors. Only vertex-normal precision changed.
The smooth anterior profile and posterior bare-area border remain distinct. The neutral enlargement shows the continuous raised ligament margin and the same subtle changes in the capsule highlight.
I turned from the anterior capsule to the posterior patch, then followed its thin bounding ligaments in the enlarged view. The patch remains independently selectable.

The full 8-mesh scene uses 41,470 triangles and 595,352 bytes, saving 168,128 bytes (22.0%). Signed normalized normal packing changes the worst vertex-normal direction by 0.372 degrees on VH_F_bare_area_of_liver. Positions, index streams and rendered silhouettes match exactly. The largest foreground color change in the reviewed channels is 1/255.
